name: amicale-conges
description: SaaS de gestion des congés, maladies et absences — Amicale du Personnel de la Banque Centrale

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npm --prefix client run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env server/index.js
